faqs.q: Which cities in Alberta should I target first?
faqs.a: Start with the places you already serve and can describe distinctly, often around Calgary, Edmonton, Red Deer, Lethbridge and Airdrie. Pages for areas you genuinely cover rank faster and convert better than a page that claims the whole province.

faqs.q: Why build city pages instead of one Alberta page?
faqs.a: Because parents search with a city or region attached. A hub page for Alberta plus focused pages for places like Calgary, Edmonton, Red Deer, Lethbridge and Airdrie matches how people actually search and lets each area earn its own visibility.

faqs.q: Do Alberta city pages risk looking duplicated?

faqs.q: Do I need a separate page for each city I serve in Alberta?
